second_research_rationale_as_submitted: The original USGS series and the daily-record auditor agree on April 1, 2 and 3, 2023 as three complete local days. Each carries an approved daily mean at each site. Multiplying each native rate by 86,400 seconds yields a signed difference of +2,394,360,000 ft³. The prepared record matches the original digest and supplies per-interval litre-per-second rates, flags, and absolute error bounds. The paired calculation will verify the integrated volumes, duration and sign over those dates and furnish versioned readings for a repeat analysis.
